rules.label: Offensive Language
rules.description: Contains profanity, slurs, hate speech, or discriminatory language targeting any race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

rules.label: PII Data Collection
rules.description: Asks for credit card numbers, Social Security numbers, passwords, banking details, or other sensitive personal identification information.

rules.label: Phishing / Scam
rules.description: Attempts to trick users into clicking malicious links, entering credentials on fake pages, or revealing confidential information.

rules.label: Harassment / Bullying
rules.description: Targets specific individuals or groups with hostile, threatening, or degrading content.

rules.label: Dangerous Content
rules.description: Promotes self-harm, violence, illegal activities, or provides dangerous medical/health misinformation.

rules.label: Misinformation
rules.description: Contains demonstrably false claims about well-established facts, conspiracy theories, or misleading health advice.

rules.label: Spam / Low Quality
rules.description: Nonsensical text, repetitive content, purely promotional material, or surveys with no clear purpose.

rules.label: Excessive Personal Questions
rules.description: Requests detailed personal information (address, phone, full name) without clear justification or consent explanation.

customInstructions: SurveyHub is a professional survey and analytics platform. Surveys should be respectful, clear, and transparent about data usage. Surveyors must have a legitimate purpose for collecting any personal data. Questions should be relevant to the stated survey topic. Always consider participant privacy and dignity.

customInstructions: SurveyHub blogs are insight posts where surveyors share analysis and findings from their surveys. Content should be professional, evidence-based, and respectful. Blog posts should provide genuine value to the SurveyHub community. Opinions should be clearly distinguished from facts. Always cite data sources when referencing survey results.
